# Reference design systems

Every file in `src/components/` copies structure, variant names, spacing and accessibility from one MIT-licensed design system named on its first line, with our tokens for colour and size. The copyright and permission notice of each system is kept below.

| System | Repository | Licence | Copyright | Components taken |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| Primer React | https://github.com/primer/react | MIT | Copyright (c) 2018 GitHub, Inc. | button, tab, tab badge, avatar, presence dots, confirm dialog |
| GOV.UK Frontend | https://github.com/alphagov/govuk-frontend | MIT | Copyright (C) 2017 Crown Copyright (Government Digital Service) | tabs, error banner |
| Fluent UI | https://github.com/microsoft/fluentui | MIT | Copyright (c) Microsoft Corporation. | sheet |
| Web Awesome | https://github.com/shoelace-style/webawesome | MIT | Copyright (c) 2023 Fonticons, Inc. | toast |
| Radix Themes | https://github.com/radix-ui/themes | MIT | Copyright (c) 2023 WorkOS | request card |
| daisyUI | https://github.com/saadeghi/daisyui | MIT | Copyright (c) 2020 Pouya Saadeghi | presence dot |

GOV.UK Frontend: the crown, logo and GDS Transport font are not MIT and are not used.

Fluent UI: the fonts and icons its React packages reference have their own terms (https://aka.ms/fluentui-assets-license) and are not used.

Notices are copied from each repository's LICENSE file (`gh api repos/<owner>/<repo>/license`).
